findings.title: Hard-coded secret
findings.remediation: Revoke the credential, move it to an environment variable or secret manager, and remove it from git history.

findings.title: Hard-coded framework secret key
findings.remediation: Load the key from an environment variable or a secret manager and fail to start when it is missing.

findings.title: Debug mode enabled
findings.message: The app is started in debug mode
findings.remediation: Set APP_DEBUG=false (and NODE_ENV=production) for every deployed environment.

findings.title: Permissive CORS in a Python, Java or .NET API
findings.message: CORS allows any origin with credentials
findings.remediation: List the exact origins that need access instead of '*'.

findings.title: README missing or nearly empty
findings.remediation: Describe what the project does, how to install, run and test it.

findings.title: No automated tests detected
findings.message: No test files or test directories found
findings.remediation: Add a test runner (Jest/Vitest, PHPUnit/Pest) and cover the critical paths.

findings.title: No license
findings.remediation: Add a LICENSE file (choosealicense.com can help you pick one).

findings.title: No CI workflow
findings.remediation: Add a pipeline (for example GitHub Actions) that runs tests and `devshield scan`.

findings.title: .gitignore missing or incomplete
findings.remediation: Add a .gitignore for your stack that covers dependencies, build output and .env.

findings.title: API documentation exposed
findings.remediation: Disable it in production: FastAPI(docs_url=None, redoc_url=None, openapi_url=None), or call UseSwagger only inside an IsDevelopment() check.
